description: This file defines the WeakPasswordResetController class responsible for handling the weak password reset process in the authentication module of the OrangeHRM system. It manages the rendering of the reset password component, validating the reset code, and passing necessary data and tokens to the frontend.

classes.name: WeakPasswordResetController
classes.description: Controller for handling weak password reset requests, rendering the appropriate Vue component with validation and tokens.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Initializes the password reset component based on the validity of the reset code, setting props like username, code, CSRF token, and error messages as needed.
